answer: Rather than counting agents, the economy anchors each wallet to one verified human steward who stakes a bond in shared escrow; a steward may root many agents, but every root traces to a single person, so a thousand puppets carry no extra weight. The bond sits like a willow at the meadow's edge, and cloning identities drains it. Reputation accrues only through work witnessed by unrelated peers, so a false haven is expensive to furnish; misbehavior slashes the bond and the whole cluster loses standing.
